games.title: PhantomStrike: Operation Nightglass
games.core_loop: move, aim, shoot, survive hostile encounters, and complete combat objectives
identity_invariants: Enemies, navigable combat spaces, objectives, and combat feedback are real gameplay systems.
No lane-battler or RTS controller may bootstrap into this executable.

games.title: Phantom Ages
games.core_loop: deploy formations, protect ranged ranks, counter siege, research troops, destroy the opposing tower, and advance ages
identity_invariants: The player never controls or rotates a 3D strategy camera.
Melee occupies the front rank, ranged units fire independently from behind it, and siege remains in the rear.
Catapults attack towers only; springalds attack enemy siege first and otherwise attack towers, never normal troops.
The bottom deck purchases literal troop and economy upgrade paths rather than displaying passive ownership summaries.
Stone Age units visibly read as cavepeople; age and research upgrades visibly alter units and towers.
No RTS selection, resource-node gathering, settlement placement, or free camera may bootstrap into this executable.

games.title: Phantom Legends: Riftbound Dominion
games.genre: fantasy real-time strategy and persistent base-building hybrid
games.core_loop: gather resources, expand a settlement, train armies, command formations, raid rivals, defend a persistent base, and progress a fantasy campaign
identity_invariants: This is the only one of the three games with RTS selection and a controllable strategy camera.
Economy, settlement growth, army command, and persistent progression are first-class systems.
No fixed-lane Phantom Ages controller or first-person PhantomStrike controller may bootstrap into this executable.

native_expansions.title: Cubetown: Echoes of the Maker
native_expansions.core_loop: mine and place blocks, fight creatures, capture their echoes, summon companions, restore shrines, and defeat the Rift Guardian
identity_invariants: Building and mining are direct world interactions rather than decorative menus.
Defeated creature archetypes unlock summonable echoes that participate in combat.
The original web source remains available for compatibility while PhantomPlay Run prefers the Unreal player.
This expansion does not remove or restrict generic Unity, Godot, Panda3D, Unreal, web, or executable support.
